vulnerability_analysis: The contract owner has excessive privileges including the ability to blacklist any address via setBlacklistEnabled(). Once blacklisted, the victim cannot sell tokens (antiSnipe.checkUser() reverts) and is excluded from dividends. This is a classic owner privilege abuse vulnerability.
attack_strategy: 1. Become the contract owner via storage slot manipulation. 2. Ensure trading is enabled by calling enableTrading() (requires liquidity to be added). 3. Give victim some tokens. 4. Blacklist the victim address. 5. Verify the victim is blacklisted.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Find and overwrite the owner storage slot (likely slot 0). 2. Impersonate ourselves as owner. 3. Check/set _hasLiqBeenAdded to true via storage manipulation. 4. Call enableTrading() as owner. 5. Use multiSendTokens() to give victim tokens. 6. Call setBlacklistEnabled(victim, true). 7. Verify antiSnipe.isBlacklisted(victim) returns true.
